notes_for_editor: Dates agree across four pages, but all are secondary lookout-history sites. The 1950 date is confirmed; the brief's abandoned is replaced by removed. The site notes (undated visit) describe footings and wire at the summit, which is the only physical-remains evidence found. No source says whether the site is open to the public.
